sources.snippet: A professional pipeline for fine-tuning the openai/whisper-small speech-to-text model on the Hindi language using the Google FLEURS dataset. This project utilizes Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with LoRA and 8-bit quantization to ensure high performance on consumer GPUs.

sources.title: levanell/whisper-small-hi-ft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description This repository contains a parameter-efficient fine-tuned (PEFT) version of OpenAI's whisper-small model, optimized specifically for Hindi Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). The model was trained using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) combined with 8-bit quantization, allowing for highly efficient training and inference without degrading the base model's underlying architecture.
